site_address: Imperial War Museum Lambeth Road London Southwark
development_description: Listed building consent for the replacement and installation of 3x permanent banners (with fixings) in each of the following locations: the front portico, the internal north atrium wall, the internal staircase of the Imperial War Museum London

conditions.summary: Development to be carried out in accordance with approved plans: 25_IWM_LON_DR_011 PROPOSED PORTICO -ELEVATION (FRONT) received 21/10/2025, 25_IWM_LON_DR_013 PROPOSED ELEVATION (FRONT) - ATRIUM STAIR received 21/10/2025, 181664 -20171348 PLAIN VIEW- STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS received 21/10/2025, STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS received 21/10/2025, IWM_SB_V STAIR BANNER- DETAIL DRAWING received 21/10/2025, DETAILED DRAWING - BRACKETS received 09/12/2025, ATRIUM WINDOW WALL BANNERS received 09/12/2025, METHOD STATEMENT received 09/12/2025

conditions.summary: Development to begin within three years from the date of this permission
conditions.source_quote: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the end of three years from the date of this permission.

conditions.summary: All new works and finishes to match existing original work in materials, execution and appearance
conditions.source_quote: All new internal/external works and finishes and works of making good shall match existing original work adjacent in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance, except where indicated otherwise on the drawings hereby approved or as required by any condition(s) attached to this consent.
